Always-on Usage is a usage and workflow encyclopedia for always-on agents (Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse), for people who want to run bots long-term without burning their quota: 1912 public entries and 26 X case studies so far, each with its author and source link.

Copy library

Guides, templates, scenario workflows, finished builds. Each has a source; open one for: what it does → scenario → how to copy → caveats.

1912 public items aggregated · Most entries are Grok Bot; Dots and Muse public cases are added in incremental rounds

Third-party titles and summaries stay in their original language — no machine rewrites.
